review_notes: I read the whole file and searched the repo for uses of rigidSixGraph and rigidSixGraph_adj. I also read SimpleGraph.sameAtomicType_iff in BackAndForth/Graph.lean. The only simp-interface concern is the global @[simp] on rigidSixGraph_adj. Nothing in the repo relies on it as a simp rule: the only other use is an explicit term in the DecidableRel instance. The other simp calls are `simp only [...]` or `simp [rigidSixGraph]`. I did not run Lean, so I make no claim about observed simplifier behaviour. Whether downstream files outside this repo depend on the attribute is unknown.

findings.excerpt:
@[simp]
theorem rigidSixGraph_adj (i j : Fin 6) : rigidSixGraph.Adj i j ↔
findings.problem: The lemma carries a global @[simp] attribute in a public section, so it is exported to every importing file. Its right-hand side is a 12-way disjunction of conjunctions of equalities. For any `rigidSixGraph.Adj a b` with non-literal `a` or `b`, simp would replace the compact predicate with that disjunction. It would do this wherever the graph appears, for example in goals produced by `SimpleGraph.sameAtomicType_iff`. A bare `rigidSixGraph.Adj` has no canonical reduced form, and this expansion is not one. It is an unwanted blow-up, and it hides the graph structure that later lemmas about symmetry or neighbours would want to see. In this file the attribute is never used by simp. The theorem is used only as an explicit term, `decidable_of_iff _ (rigidSixGraph_adj i j).symm`, and the other simp calls here are `simp only [...]` or `simp [rigidSixGraph]`. The attribute therefore has no benefit here and a clear downstream cost.
findings.proposed_change: Remove `@[simp]` from `rigidSixGraph_adj`, so it stays an explicit unfolding lemma. Callers can then opt in with `simp [rigidSixGraph_adj]` or `rw [rigidSixGraph_adj]`. If simp should decide concrete cases such as `rigidSixGraph.Adj 0 3`, add narrow lemmas for the concrete edges, or rely on the `DecidableRel` instance with `decide`. Alternatively, make the attribute local to the proof sites that need it.
findings.benefit: Importers no longer have `rigidSixGraph.Adj i j` silently rewritten into a 12-disjunct formula. Simp-normal forms stay compact, and the lemma remains available where explicit case analysis is wanted.
